response: Yes, acute fibrinous and organizing pneumonia (AFOP) is considered to be an expression of immune dysregulation. It is a rare and severe form of lung injury characterized by the accumulation of fibrin and organizing pneumonia, often in response to an underlying condition such as infection, autoimmune disease, or drug toxicity. The immune system plays a key role in the development of AFOP, and dysregulation of the immune response is thought to contribute to the disease process.
